name: Ghislaine Maxwell

summary.text: Ghislaine Maxwell is a British-born associate of Jeffrey Epstein who was convicted by a federal jury in Manhattan in December 2021 on five counts including sex trafficking of minors, and sentenced in June 2022 by U.S. District Judge Alison Nathan to 20 years in prison, a $750,000 fine and five years of supervised release. On this site she appears as one of the 'insiders' in the Epstein entry.
